description.value: A McDonald's fast-food restaurant in the Lynn Valley area of North Vancouver, offering burgers, chicken sandwiches, McCafé beverages, and desserts. The location has a drive-through and takeaway service, making it a quick stop for cyclists passing through this suburban corridor. As part of a large national chain, the range of hot and cold food and drink options is broadly consistent across locations.
